data.description:
## Description

**What**: Hash-of-record protocol: extend the attestation schema to record the diff_hash at attestation time PLUS the SHA range it covers (story-branch tip SHA + story-branch base SHA). DefenseStore.load_for_region validates by SHA-range membership in merge ancestry, not by diff_hash equality alone. Merge commits do not invalidate attestations whose covered SHA range is preserved in the merge ancestry.
**Why**: Without this, every task→story→session merge invalidates prior attestations as cache-misses, defeating SC8's <50% re-review value-signal assertion.

**Scope**:
- IN: Attestation schema extension: add story_branch_tip_sha and story_branch_base_sha fields
- IN: DefenseStore.load_for_region SHA-range membership lookup using `git log --ancestry-path` or equivalent
- IN: Schema migration for existing attestations (treat absence as legacy diff-hash-only attestation)
- OUT: Region-split attestation shape — receives input from S9

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, integration test merges story A into the session branch, then queries DefenseStore.load_for_region from a final-PR-context session and asserts story A's attestations are returned (not stale-invalidated)
  ← Satisfies: "SC6: Hash-of-record protocol"
- When this story is complete, legacy attestations without SHA-range fields fall back to diff_hash equality lookup with a logged warning
  ← Satisfies: "SC6 schema migration"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Coordinate attestation schema with S9's region-split output: region-keyed attestations must be representable in this schema. Without coordination, S10 may design a schema that cannot represent region-scoped attestations, requiring a future migration.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a CI llm-review runner, attestations record diff_hash plus SHA range covered, and DefenseStore.load_for_region validates by SHA-range membership
